newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippine peso higher on arbitrage adjustment.
newsitem.headline: Philippine peso higher on arbitrage adjustment.

text.p: The Philippine peso rose in early trade on Friday as banks adjusted their swap points to take away the effect of today's New York holiday, traders said.
Yesterday, banks had to add one day to their swap points because they can only deliver dollars on Monday, which pulled down the value of the peso.
The peso traded at 26.40/26.399 to the dollar from 26.405, with volume at $89.5 million after more than an hour of trade.
"The peso will just be steady because the Central Bank's 24 percent overnight borrowing rate hurts," a dealer said.
"It will be quiet today because of the New York holiday," another trader said.
Traders said the Central Bank quoted a bid and offer rate for the dollar at 26.30/26.40.
